visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair wears a white transparent jacket over a black textured vest and white shirt. They stand on a dark stage illuminated by two large house-shaped neon outlines. (2) Three young women appear in a different shot. One is kneeling by a table, another stands wearing a purple hoodie, and a third stands with arms crossed in gray sweatpants. The lighting is bright and even, suggesting a rehearsal space with a simple wooden table and a white backdrop. (3) A series of quick cuts showing individuals in emotional states. A woman in a purple hoodie sits on a wooden chair, holding a picture frame and crying. Another woman in a denim jacket sits at a table, looking distressed. A woman and a man sit on a white decorative garden bench; the man leans in to talk to her while she looks thoughtful. (4) The man and woman from the first scene are now sitting in front of a gray wall with a golden logo. The man wears a white shirt and a brown patterned scarf. They look directly at the camera. The scene then shifts to a group of five people standing on the original neon-lit stage, looking at the camera and smiling. (5) A celebratory group scene on the stage. The main man stands with four young women who hold a large oversized green check and a trophy. They are smiling and posing for a group photo. The lighting is bright studio lighting. (6) A final large group shot outdoors in front of a red digital screen with gold Chinese calligraphy. Numerous people in various attire, including some older adults in suits and many young people, pose with thumbs up and smiling faces in natural daylight.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 時間飛快. (2) [Subtitle]: 我們來到《戲戲品味》的總決賽啦. (3) [Subtitle]: 今天的主題叫做我的故事. (4) [Subtitle]: 最觸動人心的一件事情. (5) [Subtitle]: 代表說連整個劇本都是他們本人去完成的. (6) [Subtitle]: 是. (7) [Subtitle]: 還有邀請另外三位算是對手也是朋友一起演出. (8) [Subtitle]: 也就是說今天所有的選手要演出四場戲. (9) [Subtitle]: 而且會同時進行評分. (10) [Subtitle]: 一次要記四個劇本真的有夠挑戰的. (11) [Subtitle]: 我們來看一下他們的表現吧. (12) [Slogan]: 唐筠姍的故事-彷彿遺忘不是終點-. (13) [Subtitle]: 我就是你的珊仔啦. (14) [Subtitle]: 我真的不知道你為什麼要忘記我. (15) [Slogan]: 劉婕羚的故事-烏雲之上-. (16) [Subtitle]: 我多想抱他啊. (17) [Subtitle]: 可是我不敢. (18) [Subtitle]: 我怕那就是最後一次了. (19) [Slogan]: 徐語謙的故事-那個，她以為的愛情-. (20) [Subtitle]: 不然你考慮一下我. (21) [Subtitle]: 嗯～那我考慮一下. (22) [Subtitle]: 從第一集到現在身為主持人的我. (23) [Subtitle]: 看著大家一路成長到現在啊. (24) [Subtitle]: 滿滿的感動與不捨. (25) [Subtitle]: 恭喜獲獎的同學們. (26) [Subtitle]: 祝福每一個人經過這個節目之後啊. (27) [Subtitle]: 這都只是一個起點而不是結束. (28) [Subtitle]: 相信在未來的路上你們一定會持續發光發熱的唷.
